about: our translations of wiki texts, chunk3

texts.柯杨娜朝空中射出带有精灵祝福的箭矢，短暂延迟后箭矢分裂，如疾风骤雨般击打到目的地: 柯杨娜 shoots arrows carrying Elvenor's Blessing into the air. After a short delay the arrows split and rain down on the destination like a storm; each wave of arrows deals Lightning DMG equal to 27.6% of Physical Power to all enemy targets. The arrow rain lasts 6 waves
texts.柯杨娜的每次普通攻击命中有100%的几率给自身叠加一层【警戒印记】\n【警戒印记:
Each time 柯杨娜's Normal Attack hits, there is a 100% chance to grant herself one stack of [警戒印记]
[警戒印记]: When dealing Physical DMG, grants herself a mark stack; at 10 stacks, deals Physical DMG equal to 60% of Physical Power once to all enemies and clears the marks.
texts.每2次普攻后释放，召唤光盾，对身前5米范围内所有敌人造成500%法术强度的火焰伤: Released after every 2 Normal Attacks: summons an Aegis of Light, dealing Fire DMG equal to 500% of Spell Power to all enemies within 5 meters in front (DMG dealt reduced by 50% in the Arena), and Touch of Light gains an additional 10% + Spell Mastery 0.25% Crit Chance.
texts.每一次触发【飞星惊梦】，可积攒10点剑元；每20点剑元能让【剑落九霄】多生出一柄: Each trigger of [Flying Stars Startle Dreams] accumulates 10 Sword Essence; every 20 Sword Essence lets [Heavenfall Blades] spawn one additional auxiliary sword, which deals Holy DMG equal to 3500% of Physical Power. Sword Essence is capped at 100.
texts.每个【神圣印记】将提升10%自身攻击力，2.5%的普通攻击暴击率，普通攻击暴击时: Each [Divine Seal] increases own Attack Power by 10% and Normal Attack Crit% by 2.5%. When a Normal Attack crits, a Nova falls (trigger interval: 2 seconds), dealing Frost DMG equal to 30% of Attack Power to the target, and the target's DMG taken is additionally increased by 35%, lasting 6 seconds.
texts.每当场上有敌方单位陷入昏迷状态时，对其释放陨石造成4000%法术强度的火焰伤害。: Whenever an enemy unit on the field becomes Stunned, drops a meteor on it, dealing Fire DMG equal to 4000% of Spell Power. Trigger chance: 25% (minimum cast interval of 1 second)
texts.每当敌人被添加【麻木】、衰退、【低迷】、【迟缓】、【审判】等特殊状态时，有几率对: Whenever an enemy is afflicted with special statuses such as [Numb], Weaken, [Enfeebled], [Slow] or [Judgment], there is a chance to throw 2 Kunai Flurry at it, dealing Lightning DMG equal to 1500% of Spell Power on hit. Trigger chance: 15%. (This skill's cooldown cannot go below 1 second)
texts.每当队友释放一次必杀，赫达莱获得【能量转移】攻击速度提升6%，伤害提升6%（叠加: Each time a teammate casts an ultimate, Hedalet gains [能量转移]: Attack Speed increased by 6%, DMG increased by 6% (stack limit: 25). In addition, when Hedalet dies, he shares 100% of his current Rage evenly among all surviving allied units.
texts.每次对敌人施加【低迷】效果时，都会获得1点充能最多可获得12点充能。【衔息为引】: Each time [Enfeebled] is inflicted on an enemy, gains 1 Charge, up to 12 Charges. When [Inhaled Awakening] fires a Qi Bolt, it consumes all Charges; every 1 Charge consumed increases the Qi Bolt's DMG by 10%.
texts.每次释放【魂噬】获得1点暗蚀引力，最多获得10点释放【暗星牵引】时，消耗所有暗蚀: Each cast of [Soul Devour] grants 1 Umbral Gravity, up to 10. When casting [暗星牵引], consumes all Umbral Gravity; each 1 point consumed reduces the cooldown of [暗星牵引] by 1 second. Immediately gains 10 Umbral Gravity when entering battle.
texts.每移除一个负面状态，技能伤害增幅与攻击速度提升5%，上限2.5%*精神精通等级。: For each debuff removed, Skill DMG Boost and Attack Speed increase by 5%, capped at 2.5% * Mental Mastery level. Galahad has a (15% + Mental Power * 1%) chance to resist (Dodge (Skill)) damage. (Cooldown: 11 seconds)
texts.每隔2秒，使除自身外的所有队友恢复30怒气值。当拥有冰霜球时，消耗1个冰霜球，使: Every 2 seconds, restores 30 Rage to all teammates except self. When holding a Frost Orb, consumes 1 Frost Orb to double the Rage restored.
texts.瑞芙荔从目标脚下召唤地狱之火，短暂延迟后升起地狱火柱，对目标造成384.6%法术: Reveille summons Hellfire beneath the target. After a short delay a pillar of Hellfire rises, dealing Fire DMG equal to 384.6% of Spell Power to the target, and Fire DMG equal to 10% of Spell Power to enemies within 2.5 meters around.
texts.瑞芙荔向血量最低的目标发射由地狱之火凝聚而成的火球，对目标造成240%法术强度的: Reveille launches a Fireball condensed from Hellfire at the target with the lowest HP, dealing Fire DMG equal to 240% of Spell Power to the target, and Fire DMG equal to 10% of Spell Power to enemies within 2.5 meters around the target.
texts.瑞芙荔最为剧烈的折磨，施放狱火升腾时，有50%的几率同时施放爆裂火球: Reveille's most violent torment: when casting Hellfire Eruption, there is a 50% chance to also cast Pyroblast
texts.生命值低于75%/45%/15%时，触发护体状态，减少30%所受伤害，持续时间2: When HP falls below 75%/45%/15%, triggers the Barricade state, reducing DMG taken by 30%, lasting 2.5 seconds
texts.百花旅者选择队伍中物理强度或法术强度最高的角色进行栖身，栖身后，对被栖身的角色添: Traveler of Flowers attaches to the teammate with the highest Physical Power or Spell Power. Once attached, grants the attached character a magic Shield that can absorb 500% of Traveler of Flowers' Constitution (the Shield is refreshed on recast). And when the attached character is affected by [Scent of Falling Flowers], the Attack Speed bonus gained is increased by 100%.
texts.突进至最远目标，并对路径上敌人造成216%物理强度的物理伤害。: Dashes to the farthest target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 216% of Physical Power to enemies along the path.
texts.米奥妮疾风骤雨般射出8支箭（箭矢数量受物理精通影响），每支箭对目标造成75%物理: Myoni fires 8 arrows like a raging storm (the number of arrows is affected by Physical Mastery), each arrow dealing Physical DMG equal to 75% of Physical Power to the target.
texts.米奥妮的技巧使自身获得了10%的技能暴击几率与30%的技能暴击伤害。: Myoni's technique grants her 10% Skill Crit Chance and 30% Skill Crit Dmg.
texts.给最虚弱（血量最少）的队友增加50%攻击速度,持续5秒，并立即恢复600%法术强: Grants the Weakest (lowest HP) teammate 50% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, and instantly restores HP equal to 600% of Spell Power
texts.绞刃流火的普攻暴击几率和技能暴击几率+30%。: Blazing Shear's Normal Attack Crit Chance and Skill Crit Chance +30%.
texts.维娜势如破竹般对最远目标发动三次冲锋攻击，每次造成133.3%物理强度的物理伤害: Vina charges the farthest target three times with unstoppable force, each dealing Physical DMG equal to 133.3% of Physical Power, knocking the target airborne and Stunning it for 2 seconds.
texts.维娜将所承受的每一分创伤和疼痛转变为自身力量和回复能力。每损失5%生命值就会获得: Vina turns every bit of trauma and pain she endures into her own Strength and recovery. For every 5% HP lost, she gains 4% Physical Power and Health Regeneration equal to 30% of Attack Power.
texts.维娜朝最远的敌方目标发起猛烈的冲锋，击退沿途所有敌方单位，造成300%物理强度的: Vina launches a fierce Charge at the farthest enemy target, knocking back all enemy units along the way, dealing Physical DMG equal to 300% of Physical Power, and Stunning the enemy units hit for 2 seconds.
texts.自身10米范围内，周围的敌人所有抗性下降5%，物理抗性额外下降5%。(该效果会使: All resistances of nearby enemies within 10 meters of self are reduced by 5%, and Physical Resistance is additionally reduced by 5%. (This effect can make enemy resistance negative; every 1% of negative resistance increases the DMG of the corresponding type taken by 1%)
texts.自身受到伤害时，{50%×(0.6+0.1×天赋等级)}的伤害会转化为自身的最大: When taking DMG, {50% × (0.6 + 0.1 × talent level)} of the DMG is converted into own Max HP, lasting 10 seconds.
texts.自身受到致命伤害时，立刻对自己释放一次。【纯净祝福每隔25秒触发一次】: When taking fatal DMG, immediately casts once on self. [Divine Radiance triggers once every 25 seconds]
texts.芙萝造成伤害时，有10%几率对目标施加冰缓效果。【冰缓】:降低20%攻击速度和1: When Flo deals DMG, there is a 10% chance to apply the Chill effect to the target. [Chill]: Reduces Attack Speed by 20% and Rage Restore speed by 12% for 5 seconds.
texts.芭拉拉升级能量转移的术法，使普攻造成伤害的150%转化为治疗，平均分配给场上存活: 芭拉拉 upgrades her energy transfer spell, converting 150% of the DMG dealt by Normal Attacks into healing, distributed evenly among surviving teammates on the field
texts.芭拉拉预见了未来，获得了15%的闪避几率。并且在遭遇危险时尝试回到秘境，在濒死状:
芭拉拉 foresees the future, gaining 15% Dodge (Attack) chance. And when in danger she tries to return to the secret realm: in the near death state, 芭拉拉 gains a 30% Dodge (Skill) effect.
[Near death state]: HP below 35%
texts.获得15%闪避,每次闪避时恢复151点生命值+200%法术强度生命值。: Gains 15% Dodge (Attack); each dodge restores 151 HP + HP equal to 200% of Spell Power.
texts.获得50%技能回避,每次回避时恢复1173点生命值+350%法术强度生命值。: Gains 50% Dodge (Skill); each skill dodge restores 1173 HP + HP equal to 350% of Spell Power.
texts.触发强袭时获得1层剑意,每层剑意会获得0.05技能暴击几率和暴击伤害。且每7点物: Triggering Thunderous Aegis grants 1 stack of Blademaster; each stack grants 0.05 Skill Crit Chance and Crit Dmg. And every 7 Physical Mastery increases the Skill Crit Chance and Crit Dmg gained per stack by 0.5%. Stacks up to 5 times, lasts 20 seconds.
texts.贯通箭变更为“向前方锥形范围射出3支箭，并且贯通箭的物理强度提升6.1%。: Piercing Shots changes to “fires 3 arrows in a cone forward, and the Physical Power of Piercing Shots is increased by 6.1%.
texts.赫达莱创造的法术斗篷使他1秒内只会受到一次法术伤害，并且使该伤害降低6%(额外受: The spell cloak created by Hedalet makes him take Spell DMG only once per 1 second, and reduces that DMG by 6% (additionally affected by Spell Mastery).
texts.赫达莱向四周放出 12把飞刀，所有飞刀在完全展开2秒后飞回长夜之影所在位置，每次: Hedalet releases 12 flying daggers around him; 2 seconds after fully spreading out, all daggers fly back to Unseen Shadow's position, and each time they pass through an enemy they deal Frost DMG equal to 62.5% of Spell Power to it.
texts.赫达莱对暗夜女神的忠心侍奉得到了回报，提升赫达莱15%技能暴击率。永夜之舞在命中: Hedalet's loyal service to the Goddess of Night is rewarded, increasing Hedalet's Skill Crit% by 15%. Dance of the Eternal Night has a 10% + 2% * Spell Mastery chance on hit to apply the Chill effect.
texts.跃向距离队友最近的敌人，落地后对落点周围3.5米范围敌人造成500%法术强度的火: Leaps to the enemy closest to teammates; on landing, deals Fire DMG equal to 500% of Spell Power to enemies within 3.5 meters around the landing point (DMG dealt reduced by 50% in the Arena), pulls the monsters hit (does not work on heroes and BOSSes) to near the landing point and applies Taunt to them. If the enemies are Blackguards, Taunts the nearest 1 enemy Blackguard for 1.5 seconds.
texts.进入战斗时，立刻获得100指挥值。且【协同策略】的效果在触发时，会消耗自身所有球: When entering battle, immediately gains 100 Command Point. And when the effect of [Synergized Strategy] triggers, it consumes all of own orbs. Energy Orb: every 2 Energy Orbs consumed, missile waves +1. Fury Orb: when any Fury Orb is consumed, missiles deal DMG in a 3 meter range, and each additional 1 Fury Orb consumed gives +10% explosion range. Frost Orb: each 1 Frost Orb consumed changes the trigger interval of [Synergized Strategy] by -1 second, down to a minimum of 2 seconds. Lightning Orb: each 1 Lightning Orb consumed, missile DMG +12%.
texts.连续挥舞三次镰刀对附近的敌人造成600%法术强度的火焰伤害;【迷心魅纹】解锁后，: Swings the scythe three times in succession, dealing Fire DMG equal to 600% of Spell Power to nearby enemies; once [Alluring Phantom] is unlocked, the third hit applies Charmed Mark to the enemies hit. (The DMG counts as Skill DMG, and this effect is not affected by Attack Speed)
texts.连续释放三次攻击，分别对敌人发射一枚冰锥/四枚冰锥/一道激流，对目标/目标/路径: Unleashes three consecutive attacks, firing one Ice Cone / four Ice Cones / one Cold Torrent at enemies respectively, dealing Frost DMG equal to 250% of Spell Power to the target / target / enemies on the path. Each attack accumulates 10/15/25 Ocean Energy respectively.
texts.迷迭妖精为一名所选的友方黑卫进行充能，恢复其怒气值，恢复值为场上友方单位的总数*: Salvia Fairy charges a selected allied Blackguard, restoring its Rage; the amount restored is the total number of allied units on the field * 100. (Never more than 1000)
texts.迷迭妖精发射神秘光弹，对随机1个敌方目标造成2500%法术强度的火焰伤害，同时对: Salvia Fairy fires a mysterious light bullet, dealing Fire DMG equal to 2500% of Spell Power to 1 random enemy target, and casts Polymorph on it, lasting 2 seconds.
texts.追踪箭发射的时候有50%+物理强度*2.5%的几率额外发射一波箭矢,造成伤害的2: When Tracer Arrows fires, there is a 50% + Physical Power * 2.5% chance to fire an extra wave of arrows; 25% of the DMG dealt restores own HP
texts.造成非物理伤害时，恢复造成伤害10%的生命值: When dealing non-Physical DMG, restores HP equal to 10% of the DMG dealt
texts.释放6次居合斩后，会额外释放一次更强力的斩击新击数量为6道，斩击造成1100%法: After casting 6 Iaido Slashes, casts an additional, more powerful slash; the number of new slashes is 6, and the slashes deal Frost DMG equal to 1100% of Spell Power.
texts.释放【三祈矢破】时，每拥有一个狂怒球，都会额外发射一支箭矢，并清空所有狂怒球，最: When casting [Trio of Arrows], fires one extra arrow for each Fury Orb held and clears all Fury Orbs, firing at most 7 extra arrows.
texts.释放【寒意纷至】时，消耗所有的冰霜球和能量球。每有2个冰霜球会增加一枚冰枪(上限: When casting [Frigid Winds], consumes all Frost Orbs and Energy Orbs. Every 2 Frost Orbs add one Ice Lance (up to 5), and every 1 Energy Orb increases Ice Lance DMG by 10% (up to 100%).
texts.释放【惊雷影袭】后，获得1层锐意，锐意最多叠加3层。释放【雷龙莲华】时，每层锐意: After casting [Thunder · Shadow Strike], gains 1 stack of Determination; Determination stacks up to 3 times. When casting [Thunder · Lotus Blossom], each stack of Determination increases the DMG of [Thunder · Lotus Blossom] by 50%, and all Determination stacks are cleared.
texts.释放大招时，触发持续箭雨，对全体敌方目标造成每秒5%物理强度闪电伤害，并对所有目: When casting the ultimate, triggers a lasting arrow rain, dealing Lightning DMG equal to 5% of Physical Power per second to all enemy targets, and strikes all targets with a wave of arrow rain every 0.3 seconds, in 24 waves; 50% of the DMG dealt by the ultimate is converted into own HP.
texts.释放必杀时，对全体敌人造成150%法术强度的伤害，并添加【虚弱】状态（降低敌方目: When casting the ultimate, deals DMG equal to 150% of Spell Power to all enemies and applies [Weak] (reduces the DMG dealt by the enemy target by 25%, lasting 6 seconds)
texts.释放枪舞，每0.2秒对附近最多2名随机敌人造成12(%法术强度的冰霜伤害，持续2: Unleashes a Gun Dance, dealing 12(% Spell Power as Frost DMG to up to 2 random nearby enemies every 0.2 seconds, lasting 2 seconds. During the cast, Double Shot Pursuit is immune to Spell DMG and cannot be knocked airborne.
texts.释放气功波对最近的1名敌人造成2000%物理强度的物理伤害。(本技能的释放速度不: Releases a Qi Burst, dealing Physical DMG equal to 2000% of Physical Power to the nearest 1 enemy. (This skill's cast speed is not affected by Attack Speed, and the DMG dealt counts as Skill DMG.)
texts.释放法术的同时向目标添加易伤诅咒效果，持续4秒，持续期间受到芭芭拉的普通攻击时伤: When casting spells, also applies a Vulnerable curse to the target for 4 seconds; during this time, DMG taken from Barbara's Normal Attacks is increased by 50%
texts.锁定距离最近的1名敌人，对其发动5次强大的斩击，每次斩击造成3000%法术强度的: Locks onto the nearest 1 enemy and unleashes 5 powerful slashes on it, each dealing Lightning DMG equal to 3000% of Spell Power. During the cast, self is Invincible.
texts.闪现到最远的敌人身后，对其进行强烈的斩击(释放过程中处于无敌状态)，清空其所有怒: Blinks behind the farthest enemy and delivers a fierce slash (Invincible during the cast), clears all of its Rage and Stuns it for 2 seconds (each 100 Rage cleared adds 0.2 seconds of Stun), dealing Fire DMG equal to 8500% of Spell Power, and puts both self and that enemy into the Take off the force state for 5 seconds. Take off the force: cannot naturally restore Rage.
texts.附近有敌人时，每隔3秒凝聚两具法身，对敌方释放神光，造成3500%物理强度的物理: When enemies are nearby, condenses two Dharmakayas every 3 seconds, which release divine light at enemies, dealing Physical DMG equal to 3500% of Physical Power; each 1 point of Divine Power held increases this skill's DMG by 1%, and all Divine Power is consumed. After learning this skill, [Swallow Darts] and [Soaring Chasing] grant 5/15 Divine Power respectively when cast; Divine Power is capped at 50.
texts.集中精力持续维持一个攻击型场域，场域每0.3秒朝周围敌人发射一枚光弹，造成100: With full Concentration, continuously maintains an offensive field that fires a light bullet at surrounding enemies every 0.3 seconds, dealing Lightning DMG equal to 1000% of Spell Power and a 0.1 second Stun; the continuous cast is not interrupted by Taunt or Silence effects. This skill is cast when Rage reaches the maximum; after casting, Rage decreases by 300 per second until Rage reaches 0, ending the skill.
texts.露塔会给血量最低的己方英雄添加回春效果，每秒恢复18.9%法术强度生命，并获得1: Luta applies Rejuvenation to the allied hero with the lowest HP, restoring HP equal to 18.9% of Spell Power per second and granting a 15% DMG reduction effect, lasting 8 seconds
texts.露塔在对队友进行治疗时，有100%的几率驱散被治疗者一个异常状态，释放必杀后增加: When Luta heals teammates, there is a 100% chance to dispel one abnormal status from the healed target. After casting the ultimate, increases the whole team's Attack Power by 30% and Physical & Spell Power by 30%, lasting 8 seconds.
texts.露塔对最近的敌人释放6道光弹，每颗光弹命中造成30%法术强度的闪电伤害并偷取目标: Luta fires 6 light bullets at the nearest enemy; each bullet hit deals Lightning DMG equal to 30% of Spell Power and steals 15 energy from the target, and reduces the target's Accuracy by 75%, lasting 8 seconds
texts.露塔普通攻击暴击将消耗80点能量释放一道治疗链，在不同已方英雄之间弹射，最多弹射: When Luta's Normal Attack crits, consumes 80 energy to release a Healing Chain that bounces between different allied heroes, up to 8 times. Each bounce restores HP equal to 8.9% of Spell Power (can bounce 2 times repeatedly), while reducing the cooldown of all active skills by 1 second
texts.露塔朝随机2个敌方单位所在位置投掷治愈光球，造成范围2.5米内78.8%法术强度: Luta throws healing light orbs at the positions of 2 random enemy units, dealing Lightning DMG equal to 78.8% of Spell Power within a 2.5 meter range; allied units caught in it receive a healing effect of 157.5% Spell Power.
texts.露塔释放光束，在不同敌方角色之间弹射，最多弹射16次。每次造成25%法术强度闪电: Luta releases a beam that bounces between different enemy characters, up to 16 times. Each bounce deals Lightning DMG equal to 25% of Spell Power and Stuns the target for 0.5 seconds
